issues.issue: Did the PRRA officer reasonably assess medical availability in Pakistan under s. 97(1)(b)(iv)?
issues.applicant_position: PRRA officer ignored the medical evidence and did not assess the risk of losing medical care in Pakistan.
issues.respondent_position: Officer clearly understood the medical documents; need not cite each one; s. 97(1)(b)(iv) excludes risk from inadequate health care.
issues.result_quote: The decision was not unreasonable in the particular context of paragraph 97(1)(b) of the IRPA.

issues.issue: Did the PRRA officer err by not treating the political and medical risks together and by weighing the RPD credibility findings?
issues.applicant_position: Officer failed to consider the combined political and medical risk and the totality of the evidence.
issues.respondent_position: Risks were presented and considered as two separate grounds; officer need not mention each piece of evidence; RPD credibility weight was not undue.
issues.result_quote: The applicant has not shown how the PRRA decision was flawed otherwise.
